trigger: Win32_DiskPartition answers S_OK with no instances (damaged repository)
summary: A clean query returning zero partitions rendered as a supported, empty section. Fixed: windows:partitions:no_rows is constrained (9a2ff231a); the test that pinned the old behaviour was flipped.
classification_rationale: the leg claimed a clean read it could not support

trigger: allocation failure inside the catch arm
summary: The catch arm logged and wrote before setting the typed status, so a second allocation failure left UNDECLARED with rc 0. Fixed: typed status first straight through the SDK, then log, then a status row only if none was written (9a2ff231a, 4c36211c9). Residual: an allocation failure inside the SDK wrapper itself is irreducible and documented.

trigger: wmi_next_failed_0x80041010 after rows were read
summary: classify_error forked the shared stage-aware agents/shared/wmi_error_token.hpp classifier and dropped rows_before_error. Fixed: shared classifier + rows_before_error + the stage-prefix static_assert.
classification_rationale: extend the single WMI-token policy, never fork it

trigger: association row unparsable or more than 256 links
summary: An unusable or truncated association left unmatched rows as a plain "-" with detail wmi. Fixed: wmi,mount_points_partial (every row once the join is untrusted); README/YAML/changelog no longer claim a failed join is never rendered as none.
classification_rationale: doc and code disagreed about unread joins

trigger: a key name ending in DeviceID in the CIM path
summary: path_key_value matched DeviceID=" unanchored. Fixed: key-boundary anchored, with a retry after a non-boundary match.

trigger: reading any of them after this change

classification_rationale: comments and capability text contradicted the code

trigger: slow WMI provider during the daily sync
summary: Each WMI query carried the helper 60 s default; fixed to a 15 s enumeration deadline per query (connect keeps WMI max-wait, documented as bounded, not instantaneous).

trigger: provider returns a malformed Size
summary: A present but non-numeric Size renders "-" with no token and the section stays supported. A "-" size already means unread; the same convention as every other column. No change.

waiver_rationale: pre-existing in untouched code; this change neither adds nor widens it; filed as its own bug rather than folded into a Windows-partitions PR (Gate 7 Test 1: independent surface)
trigger: a USB device (or provider) reporting a model string containing a pipe or newline

A device model string containing "|" shifts columns. Not introduced or made newly reachable by this change; to be filed as its own bug.
classification_rationale: sibling parity finding on untouched code
disposition: deferred-to-issue #? (unfiled: filed when the PR is opened, with the owner go-ahead)

trigger: every clean read
summary: A clean read declared OK/FULL with provenance windows:partitions, storing a clean section with a reason and asserting a completeness the descriptor denies. Fixed: a clean read declares nothing (derived OK, empty provenance), like smart/volumes.

trigger: a lettered volume on a dynamic disk or Storage Space
summary: Dynamic disks, Storage Spaces, BitLocker and non-English Type strings are unmeasured; a lettered volume the association class does not map would read as "no mount point". Measurement was attempted: Windows refuses to convert a virtual disk to dynamic on the test host, so the trigger stays unmeasured. Closed by DESIGN instead: a Win32_LogicalDisk (DriveType 3) cross-check makes any unplaced local letter a constrained section (4c36211c9, hardened in 9fcce06eb). Caveat 5 states what is unmeasured.
classification_rationale: wrong-result class made detectable rather than assumed absent

trigger: macOS sample not recaptured
summary: The macOS sample leg-hash is stale because the Windows descriptor changed. Stamping without a recapture would claim a fresh capture that does not exist. OPEN: needs a capture on a Mac (command recorded in the PR notes).

trigger: USB/VHD disk attached or removed between Win32_DiskPartition and Win32_LogicalDiskToPartition
summary: A disk attached or removed between the two queries could attach a letter to the wrong partition or lose it, silently. Fixed: an association naming an unlisted partition is windows:partitions:mount_points:unmatched_link (constrained, every row partial).

trigger: dynamic disk or Storage Space
summary: See xp-F1-dynamic-disks: same class, closed by the Win32_LogicalDisk cross-check (unplaced_volume).
classification_rationale: duplicate of xp-F1 from a second reviewer

trigger: two successive small allocation failures
summary: Double allocation failure in the catch arm left the result UNDECLARED. Mitigated (see sec-F2); the residual is an allocation failure inside the SDK set_result_status wrapper, irreducible without a raw C-ABI call the SDK does not expose, and it needs the process to be out of memory.

trigger: stalled disk, transient WMI blip, more than 256 partitions
summary: One sick disk stalls the whole class (zero rows for healthy disks); a transient failure replaces the last-good rows server-side; row-cap selection happens in provider order before the sort. Inherent to a one-shot WMI read; documented tokens make it visible. Parked for the roadmap with the other WMI-leg robustness items.
classification_rationale: design limit, not a defect of this change
disposition: roadmap-#? (unparked: filed when the PR is opened)

trigger: various environmental conditions
summary: Boot warm-up race reading "damaged repository"; legitimately-zero-partition hosts always constrained; very long provider strings (writer clamps fields to 1024 and trims partition rows first, verified safe); the association query touching removable drives; concurrent runs. All visible, diagnosable and bounded; no code change.

trigger: a process-wide COM security configuration
summary: A restrictive process-wide CoInitializeSecurity could make 0x80041003 misattribute as denied. Disproved: grep of agents/ and server/ finds no CoInitializeSecurity call (only a comment in filesystem_posture saying it is deliberately absent), and the same helper runs the hardware, firmware and app_control legs in production.

trigger: shutdown during dispatch; provider garbage
summary: Plugin unload during an operator dispatch (sync path verified safe: thread joined before handles go) and duplicate DeviceIDs (verified harmless: table key is agent_id+ord). No action.

trigger: Win32_LogicalDisk returns empty or garbled rows while a lettered volume is unplaced
summary: The Win32_LogicalDisk cross-check had no "could not read" arm: an empty answer, or rows with no usable DriveType/letter, passed vacuously. Fixed in 9fcce06eb: the cross-check is std::optional (nullopt = not run), an empty answer on a host with partitions is logical_disks:no_rows, an unusable row is logical_disks:row_unparsed; tests pin both and a mutant harness confirms them.

trigger: RAM disk / VeraCrypt-style mount / hot-plug mid-read
summary: RAM disks, virtual-filesystem drives and a letter attached between the queries yield a stable or one-cycle constrained state. Fail-safe direction; README now says what to look for (volumes, expected causes). One record then hash-skip.
